# EvPaginationItem

> One page tile of a Pagination: a 32px square button, or the inert ellipsis standing in for a run of hidden pages.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:pagination-item` |
| Layer | Atom (`src/atoms`) |
| Import | `import { EvPaginationItem } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvPaginationItem>` or `<ev-pagination-item>` |
| Source | `src/atoms/pagination-item/EvPaginationItem.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<span class="ev-pagination-item">` |
| Used inside | `evoq-ui:pagination` (EvPagination) |

## Example

```vue
<EvPaginationItem
  :page="3"
  active
/>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

## Props (5)

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | `number \| string` | — | no | The page this tile jumps to. Rendered as its label. |
| `active` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Marks the page currently on screen. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | — |
| `more` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Figma's `State=More`: the ellipsis tile standing in for a run of hidden pages. It is inert, so it renders as a span rather than a button. |
| `moreLabel` | `string` | `'Halaman lainnya'` | no | Accessible name of the ellipsis tile. |

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Pagination**, frame `4410:83059` (Pagination). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use to break long lists or tables into pages (Number / Display), or to step through a bounded sequence such as a wizard or onboarding flow (Step).

### When not to use

- Don't use for continuously streamed feeds — use infinite scroll or a "Load more" button (`evoq-ui:button`). Don't paginate very short lists that fit on one screen.

### Do

- Always show the current position and total. Keep Previous/Next reachable and disable them at the first/last page. Use the ellipsis (More L/R) to truncate long page ranges.

### Don't

- Don't show every page number for large sets — collapse the middle with an ellipsis. Don't mix Step and Number patterns in the same flow.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvPaginationItem`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<span class="ev-pagination-item">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:pagination-item` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
